```{r}
#Import the bird data set using the read.csv command####
#birds_2014 <- read.csv("C:/Users/Lenovo/Documents/BTR/Bird_Data_New/test.csv")
birds_2015 <- read.csv("C:/Users/Lenovo/Documents/BTR/Bird_Data_New/STOC-EPS-2015-ASSEMBLE.csv")
birds_2016 <- read.csv("C:/Users/Lenovo/Documents/BTR/Bird_Data_New/STOC-EPS-2016_assemble.csv")
birds_2017 <- read.csv("C:/Users/Lenovo/Documents/BTR/Bird_Data_New/STOC-EPS-2017_assemble.csv")
birds_2018 <- read.csv("C:/Users/Lenovo/Documents/BTR/Bird_Data_New/STOC-EPS-2018_assemble.csv")
birds_2019 <- read.csv("C:/Users/Lenovo/Documents/BTR/Bird_Data_New/STOC-EPS-2019-ASSEMBLE.csv")
birds_2021 <- read.csv("C:/Users/Lenovo/Documents/BTR/Bird_Data_New/STOC-EPS-2021.csv")
birds_2024 <- read.csv("C:/Users/Lenovo/Documents/BTR/Bird_Data_New/STOC-EPS-2024-ASSEMBLE.csv")

#Remove all extra columns void of information####
#Compares left of %in% to the right, if matching, because of "!", the code returns it as FALSE and removes it from the dataframe.
birds_2015 <- birds_2015[, !(names(birds_2015) %in% paste0("X.", 15))]
birds_2016 <- birds_2016[, !(names(birds_2016) %in% paste0("X.", 15))]
birds_2017 <- birds_2017[, !(names(birds_2017) %in% paste0("X.", 15))]
birds_2018 <- birds_2018[, !(names(birds_2018) %in% paste0("X.", 15))]
birds_2019 <- birds_2019[, !(names(birds_2019) %in% paste0("X.", 15))]
birds_2021 <- birds_2021[, !(names(birds_2021) %in% paste0("X.", 15))]
birds_2024 <- birds_2024[, !(names(birds_2024) %in% paste0("X.", 15))]

#REMOVING TRANSIT DATA####
#Create a function, create a loop, apply that function and save each year in a list
remove_obs <- function(df, column) {
  df[!df[[column]] %in% c("TOTAL", "Vol", "en chemin", ">200m","Vol (<200m)", ""),] #"Vol (<200m)" and "" or smth
} #df is the dataframe, column is the columns the name of the column to filter by. Matches on both sides of the %in% and removes it due to the "!".

#Create a list of all your yearly datasets, "data" is the name of the dataset, "col" is the desired column you would like to filter
birds_list <- list(
 # birds_2014 = list(data = birds_2014, col = "X.14"),
  birds_2015 = list(data = birds_2015, col = "X.14"),
  birds_2016 = list(data = birds_2016, col = "X.14"),
  birds_2017 = list(data = birds_2017, col = "X.14"),
  birds_2018 = list(data = birds_2018, col = "X.14"),
  birds_2019 = list(data = birds_2019, col = "X.14"),
  birds_2021 = list(data = birds_2021, col = "X.14"),
  birds_2024 = list(data = birds_2024, col = "X.14")
)

for(i in names(birds_list)){
  birds_list[[i]]$data <- remove_obs(birds_list[[i]]$data, birds_list[[i]]$col)
}

#names(birds_list) → gives the names of each list element: "birds_2014", "birds_2015", etc.
  #for(i in names(birds_list)) → loops over each dataset.
    #birds_list[[i]]$data → selects the dataframe for the current year.
      #birds_list[[i]]$col → selects the column name to filter by.
        #remove_obs(...) → applies the filtering function.
          #<- → replaces the old dataframe with the cleaned version.

new_colnames <- c(
  "Subsite","Site","Type (Restauration active / passive / control)","julian_day",
  "Date","Heure debut","1er ou 2e passage",
  "cloudiness", "rain", "wind", "visibility", "surface_water",
  "Observer Name","Department","Distance"
)

birds_list <- lapply(birds_list, function(x) {
  names(x$data)[1:length(new_colnames)] <- new_colnames
  return(x)
})

head(birds_list$birds_2015$data)
```

```{r}
#Removing repeated header rows#### 

#1. Extract the cleaned dataframes from the list
cleaned_dfs <- lapply(birds_list, function(x) x$data)

cleaned_dfs <- lapply(cleaned_dfs, function(df) {
  df[-1, ]  # remove the first row
})

#2. Identify all columns across all years
all_cols <- unique(unlist(lapply(cleaned_dfs, names)))

#3. Ensure all dataframes have the same columns
# If a column doesn’t exist in a year, fill with NA
standardize_cols <- function(df, all_cols) {
  missing_cols <- setdiff(all_cols, names(df))
  if(length(missing_cols) > 0){
    df[missing_cols] <- NA  # add missing columns
  }
  df <- df[all_cols]        # reorder columns consistently
  return(df)
}
cleaned_dfs <- lapply(cleaned_dfs, standardize_cols, all_cols = all_cols)

#4. Combine all years into a single dataset
birds_all_years <- do.call(rbind, cleaned_dfs)

birds_all_years$Subsite <- gsub("Platelet\\s+","Platelet", birds_all_years$Subsite)

head(birds_all_years)
```

```{r}
# Convert other weather columns to numeric
climate_cols <- c("cloudiness", "rain", "wind", "visibility")
birds_all_years[, climate_cols] <- lapply(birds_all_years[, climate_cols], function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
```

```{r}
#CREATING DATASET FOR SURFACE_WATER TREND ANALYSIS####

# Ensure numeric and factor columns
birds_all_years <- birds_all_years %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Date, format="%m/%d/%Y"),
    Site = as.factor(Site),
    `1er ou 2e passage` = as.factor(`1er ou 2e passage`)
  )
birds_all_years <- birds_all_years %>%
  mutate(
    year = format(Date, "%Y"),
    .after = Date
  ) %>%
  relocate(site = Site, passage = `1er ou 2e passage`, .after = year)

birds_all_years <- birds_all_years %>%
  filter(!is.na(year) & !is.na(Subsite))
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)
#Extracting Species Data into long format####

# Metadata columns
meta_names <- 1:16

# Species columns
species_cols <- (17:ncol(birds_all_years))

birds_long <- birds_all_years %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(species_cols),
    names_to = "species",
    values_to = "abundance"
  )
birds_long <- birds_long %>%
  mutate(
    abundance = trimws(abundance),              # remove spaces
    abundance = ifelse(abundance == "", NA, abundance),
    abundance = as.numeric(abundance)           # convert to numeric
  )

```

```{r}
  mutate(line_id = paste(Subsite, Date, passage, sep = "_"))

line_abundance <- birds_filtered %>%
  group_by(line_id) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
species_by_line <- birds_filtered %>%
  group_by(line_id, species) %>%
  summarise(
    abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

community_matrix <- species_by_line %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = species,
    values_from = abundance,
    values_fill = 0
  )

metadata <- birds_filtered %>%
  select(
    line_id,
    Subsite,
    `Type (Restauration active / passive / control)`,
    julian_day,
    Date,
    year,
    site,
    passage,
    `Heure debut`,
    cloudiness,
    rain,
    wind,
    visibility,
    surface_water,
    `Observer Name`,
    Department
  ) %>%
  distinct(line_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

line_ids <- metadata$line_id

community_matrix_subsite <- metadata %>%
  left_join(community_matrix, by = "line_id")

community_matrix_subsite <- community_matrix_subsite %>%
  mutate(
    Subsite = str_trim(Subsite),                 # remove leading/trailing spaces
    Subsite = str_replace_all(Subsite, "\\s+", ""),  # remove ALL spaces
  Subsite = str_replace(Subsite, "^Enfores", "Enfor"),  # enfores → enfor
    Subsite = str_replace(Subsite, "^Enfor(?=\\d)", "Enfor") # keep format clean
    )

community_matrix_subsite <- community_matrix_subsite %>%
  mutate(
    `Observer Name` = str_trim(`Observer Name`),
    
    `Observer Name` = case_when(
      # Marc Thibault
      `Observer Name` %in% c("M. Thibault", "Marc Thibault", "MTT", "M.Thibault") ~ "Marc Thibault",
      # Yves Kayser
      `Observer Name` %in% c("YK", "Yves Kayser") ~ "Yves Kayser",
      # Thomas G
      `Observer Name` %in% c("Thomas Galewski", "Galewski", "TGI", "Thomas G") ~ "Thomas G",
      # TBN
      `Observer Name` %in% c("TBN-Carole Leray", "TBN", "TBN + Aurore") ~ "TBN",
            # Cohez
      `Observer Name` %in% c("COHEZ", "D. Cohez", "Damien Cohez") ~ "Cohez",
      
      TRUE ~ `Observer Name`
    )
  )

birds_2024 <- birds_2024[-1, ]
names(birds_2024)[1] <- "Subsite"
names(birds_2024)[3] <- "Type de Restauration"


birds_2024 <- birds_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    `Type de Restauration` = case_when(
      `Type de Restauration` %in% c("Témoin (Bélugue, DPM)") ~ "Control",
      `Type de Restauration` == "Anciens salins - passif" ~ "Passive",
      `Type de Restauration` == "Anciens salins - actif" ~ "Active",
      `Type de Restauration` == "anciens salins - actif" ~ "Active",
      TRUE ~ `Type de Restauration`  # keep everything else unchanged
    )
  )
control <- birds_2024%>%
  select(Subsite, `Type de Restauration`)

control_unique <- control %>%
  select(Subsite, `Type de Restauration`) %>%
  distinct()

community_matrix_subsite  <- left_join(community_matrix_subsite, control_unique, by = "Subsite")

community_matrix_subsite <- community_matrix_subsite %>%
  rename(restauration=`Type de Restauration` )
```

```{r}
species_mat <- as.matrix(
  community_matrix_subsite[, -(c(1:16, tail(seq_len(ncol(community_matrix_subsite)), 2)))]
)
keep_rows <- rowSums(species_mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0 # combinations with 0 obs don't work in bray

species_mat <- species_mat[keep_rows, ]
meta <- community_matrix_subsite[keep_rows, ]

meta$surface_water_binom <- meta$surface_water 
meta$surface_water_binom[meta$surface_water_binom>0] <- 1 
meta$surface_water_binom[is.na(meta$surface_water_binom)] <- 0

meta$cover_binom <- meta$cover 
meta$cover_binom[meta$cover_binom>0.3] <- 1 
meta$cover_binom[is.na(meta$cover_binom)] <- 0
```

```{r}
library(FD)
library(ade4)

#import functional trait dataset
df_traits <- read_excel("C:/Users/Lenovo/Documents/BTR/Statistics/community_matrix_subsite_EG.xlsx", sheet = "Traits_storchova") # tableau avec les traits en colonne et espèces en ligne

#Adding niche in camargue or LMCS to data:
species_info <- read_excel("C:/Users/Lenovo/Documents/BTR/Bird_Data/Espece nicheur-revMT.xlsx")

species_info <- species_info %>%
  rename(
    Species = Noms.Especes,
    migrant = `Migrant/Vagrant`,
    niche_lmcs = `Niche LMCS`,
    niche_camargue = `Niche Camargue`
  )



df_traits <- df_traits %>%
  left_join(species_info, by = "Species")

#pick variables
df_traits_clean <- as.data.frame(df_traits[,c("Wetland","Grassland","Shrubland","Forest", "Folivore_B", "Granivore_B","Other_invertebrates_B","Fish_B")]) #,"Incubation_period","niche_camargue", "niche_lmcs"
rownames(df_traits_clean) <- df_traits$Species

#determine number of axes
traits.dist<-gowdis(df_traits_clean)  # utilisation de l'indice de gower pour faire la matrice de distance
traits.pcoa=cailliez((traits.dist))
pcoa_traits<-dudi.pco(traits.pcoa) # voir combien il faut garder d'axes (ici 4) 
4

#create PCoA
PCOA1<-unlist(pcoa_traits$li[,1])
PCOA2<-unlist(pcoa_traits$li[,2])
PCOA3<-unlist(pcoa_traits$li[,3])
PCOA4<-unlist(pcoa_traits$li[,4])

traits_matrix<-cbind(PCOA1,PCOA2,PCOA3,PCOA4)

rownames(traits_matrix) <- df_traits$Species


#rownames(traits_matrix) <- rownames(df_traits_clean)

#combine with abundance data
# abundance matrix
data_abondance <- species_mat

# make sure it's a matrix
data_abondance <- as.matrix(data_abondance)

# keep only shared species
common_species <- intersect(rownames(traits_matrix), colnames(data_abondance))

traits_matrix <- traits_matrix[common_species, ]
data_abondance <- data_abondance[, common_species]

# remove empty sites
row_sums <- rowSums(data_abondance, na.rm = TRUE)
data_abondance <- data_abondance[row_sums > 0, ]

# align metadata AFTER filtering
line_ids <- line_ids[row_sums > 0]

# remove species that are never observed
species_totals <- colSums(data_abondance, na.rm = TRUE)

data_abondance <- data_abondance[, species_totals > 0]

# also filter traits accordingly
traits_matrix <- traits_matrix[colnames(data_abondance), ]


FDall<-dbFD(traits_matrix,data_abondance)

FRichness<-FDall$FRic
FEvenness<-FDall$FEve
FDivergence<-FDall$FDiv
FSpecialization<-FDall$FSpe

FDall
```

```{r}
eig <- dpbird$eig
var_explained <- eig / sum(eig) * 100
var_explained
colnames(communities)[1:2] <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")
x_lab <- paste0("DPCoA1 (", round(var_explained[1], 1), "%)")
y_lab <- paste0("DPCoA2 (", round(var_explained[2], 1), "%)")


vars <- c("restauration","year", "surface_water", "initial_cover")

for (v in vars) {

  centroids <- aggregate(
    cbind(Axis1, Axis2) ~ get(v),
    data = communities,
    FUN = mean
  )
  colnames(centroids)[1] <- v

  p <- ggplot(communities, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, colour = .data[[v]])) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    stat_ellipse(aes(group = .data[[v]]), level = 0.68, linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = centroids,
               aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, colour = .data[[v]]),
               size = 5, shape = 4, stroke = 1.5) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste("DPCoA grouped by", v),
      x = x_lab,
      y = y_lab,
      colour = v
    )

  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
#RESULTS FOR PAPER DPCOA####

library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
communities$surface_water <- communities$surface_water *10

label_names <- c(
  restauration = "restoration",
  year = "year",
  surface_water = "surface water",
  initial_cover = "initial vegetation"
)

vars <- c("restauration","year", "surface_water", "initial_cover")

plot_list <- list()

for (v in vars) {

  p <- ggplot(communities, aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, colour = .data[[v]])) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
  title = paste("Grouped by", label_names[v]),
  x = x_lab,
  y = y_lab,
  colour = label_names[v]
)

  # Ellipses + centroids for categorical variables
  if (v %in% c("restauration", "year")) {

    centroids <- aggregate(
      cbind(Axis1, Axis2) ~ get(v),
      data = communities,
      FUN = mean
    )
    colnames(centroids)[1] <- v

    p <- p +
      stat_ellipse(aes(group = .data[[v]]), level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_point(data = centroids,
                 aes(x = Axis1, y = Axis2, colour = .data[[v]]),
                 size = 5, shape = 4, stroke = 1.5)
  }

  # ✅ Apply color scales AFTER creating the plot
  if (v == "surface_water") {
    p <- p + scale_colour_gradient(low ="#1B0078" , high = "#12cff3")
  }

  if (v == "initial_cover") {
    p <- p + scale_colour_gradient(low = "#0b2c24", high = "#00ee6e")
  }

  plot_list[[v]] <- p
}

wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2)
```

```{r}
#PERMANOVA AXIS####
library(vegan)

# Build correct dataframe
axes <- as.data.frame(dpbird$li[, 1:2])
colnames(axes) <- c("Axis1", "Axis2")

dpcoa_data <- cbind(communities, axes)

keep <- complete.cases(dpcoa_data$Axis1,
                       dpcoa_data$Axis2,
                       dpcoa_data$restauration,
                       dpcoa_data$year,
                       dpcoa_data$surface_water,
                       dpcoa_data$Change,
                       dpcoa_data$initial_cover)

dpcoa_clean <- dpcoa_data[keep, ]
dist_dpcoa <- dist(dpcoa_clean[, c("Axis1", "Axis2")])

#Run Permanova
PERMANOVA_dpcoa <- adonis2(
  dist_dpcoa ~ restauration * year+surface_water+initial_cover*Change, data = dpcoa_clean, by = "terms")

PERMANOVA_dpcoa
```

```{r}
#PAIRWISE PERMANOVA####
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Convert RaoDis to matrix
Rao <- as.matrix(dpbird$RaoDis)

# 2. Remove rows/cols with NA
keep <- complete.cases(Rao) &
        complete.cases(communities) &
        communities$surface_water != "n.a"

Rao_clean <- Rao[keep, keep]
meta_clean <- communities[keep, ]

# 3. Define pairwise indices
AC_idx <- meta_clean$restauration %in% c("Active", "Control")
PC_idx <- meta_clean$restauration %in% c("Passive", "Control")
AP_idx <- meta_clean$restauration %in% c("Active", "Passive")

# 4. Subset distance matrices
Rao_AC <- as.dist(Rao_clean[AC_idx, AC_idx])
Rao_PC <- as.dist(Rao_clean[PC_idx, PC_idx])
Rao_AP <- as.dist(Rao_clean[AP_idx, AP_idx])

# 5. Subset metadata
meta_AC <- meta_clean[AC_idx, ]
meta_PC <- meta_clean[PC_idx, ]
meta_AP <- meta_clean[AP_idx, ]




# 6. Run PERMANOVA
PERMANOVA_AC <- adonis2(Rao_AC ~ restauration * year+surface_water+initial_cover*Change,
                        data = meta_AC,
                        by = "terms")

PERMANOVA_PC <- adonis2(Rao_PC ~ restauration * year+surface_water+initial_cover*Change,
                        data = meta_PC,
                        by = "terms")

PERMANOVA_AP <- adonis2(Rao_AP ~ restauration * year+surface_water+initial_cover*Change,
                        data = meta_AP,
                        by = "terms")

# Results
PERMANOVA_AC
PERMANOVA_PC
PERMANOVA_AP
```

```{r}
#PERMANOVA RAODIS####
# 1. Convert RaoDis to matrix
Rao <- as.matrix(dpbird$RaoDis)

# 2. Identify rows WITHOUT any NA
keep <- complete.cases(Rao) &
        complete.cases(communities) &
        communities$surface_water != "n.a"

# 3. Subset distance matrix
Rao_clean <- Rao[keep, keep]

# 4. Subset metadata accordingly
meta_clean <- communities[keep, ]

# 5. Convert back to dist object
Rao_clean <- as.dist(Rao_clean)

# 6. Run PERMANOVA
PERMANOVA_RAO <- adonis2(Rao_clean ~ restauration * year+surface_water+initial_cover*Change,
                         data = meta_clean,
                         by = "terms")

PERMANOVA_RAO
```
```{r}
#EXTRACTION OF PAIRWISE PERMANOVA RESULTS####
library(broom)
library(dplyr)

#Extract clean results into data frames
extract_adonis <- function(model, comparison_name) {
  as.data.frame(model) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    mutate(comparison = comparison_name)
}

#Apply to all three
AC_tab <- extract_adonis(PERMANOVA_AC, "AC")
PC_tab <- extract_adonis(PERMANOVA_PC, "PC")
AP_tab <- extract_adonis(PERMANOVA_AP, "AP")
RAO_tab <- extract_adonis(PERMANOVA_RAO, "RAO")
Axes_tab <- extract_adonis(PERMANOVA_dpcoa, "Axes")
#Combine into one table
final_table <- bind_rows(AC_tab, PC_tab, AP_tab, RAO_tab, Axes_tab)

#Clean column names
final_table <- final_table %>%
  rename(
    Df = Df,
    SumOfSqs = SumOfSqs,
    R2 = R2,
    F = F,
    p_value = `Pr(>F)`
  )
```
